no_trade_reason: The 640/650 call debit spread costs 4.55 per share at mid for a 10-point width, so the breakeven of 644.55 sits 0.9% above the 638.75 spot with the 20-day high only at 641.20; the payoff needs a move SPY has not made in twenty sessions, and the 0.60 net bid/ask spread eats a further 13% of the debit.
